question_text: What was the average detection confidence across all events on 2025-12-08 (UTC)? Report to two decimal places.

gold.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(confidence), 2) AS avg_conf FROM events WHERE timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'

metadata.note: AVG over a real-valued column across the entire day.
